title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 49-52 (Padmamaladhara, Devi, Padmini, Padmagandhini)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 49 to 52: Padmamaladhara, Devi, Padmini, Padmagandhini, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 49 to 52 with meaning
caption: Names 49 to 52 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 49 to 52**: **Padmamaladhara, Devi, Padmini, Padmagandhini**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Padmamaladhara, Devi, Padmini, Padmagandhini.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

sections.h: Padmamaladhara: Wearer of a lotus garland
p: **Padmamaladhara** means **Wearer of a lotus garland**. Sri Suktam describes her with a garland of lotuses.
**Devi** means **The Goddess**. The word Devi means the shining, divine feminine.
**Padmini** means **Lady of the lotuses**. Padmini: lady of the lotus pond, a sign of auspiciousness.
**Padmagandhini** means **Lotus-scented**. Her presence is imagined as fragrant as the lotus.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
